About the RAR Front Range See You Next Tuesday Ride group ride

The Front Range chapter of Radical Adventure Riders runs a monthly Tuesday evening ride for FTWN-B and BIPOC riders, plus bikepacking trips and an annual gravel camp. Small and friendly; new faces are usual. The chapter's Instagram is the source of truth for dates.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
